rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible general blastocyst description and acknowledges image limitations, but the grading is broad/speculative (4BB/5BB/4BC/5BC) and omits more specific visible features such as zona thinning/hatching status.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, BMI, and endometrium well, with appropriate emphasis on endometriosis and prior miscarriage/failed cycle as modifiers of prognosis.

Reasoning is generally logical and the implantation estimate follows from the stated positives and negatives, though some recommendations (e.g., ERA, immunologic workup) are stronger than the evidence presented supports.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF practice (SET, consideration of endometriosis, cautious view of PGT-A at age 28), but ERA and immunologic testing are not routinely recommended by major guidelines, and recommending ERA before this transfer is not strongly evidence-based.

Gives clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, lifestyle optimization, and further uterine/endometriosis evaluation if unsuccessful, though some suggestions are somewhat overreaching.
